title: Optimize Committing-Security Constants for EtEP-HCTR2 and EtES-HCTR2
summary: The committing-security bounds for EtEP-HCTR2 and EtES-HCTR2 are tight up to constants depending on n, whose further optimization remains open.

formal_statement.body: The committing-security bounds for EtEP-HCTR2 and EtES-HCTR2 are tight up to constants depending on the parameter $n$. Further optimize these $n$-dependent constants.

scope.domain: This problem concerns committing-security bounds for the EtEP-HCTR2 and EtES-HCTR2 symmetric-cryptographic constructions.
parameters: n: parameter governing the constants in the tight committing-security bounds
scope.unresolved_remainder: Optimize the constants depending on n in the committing-security bounds for EtEP-HCTR2 and EtES-HCTR2.

citations.label: Key Committing Security of HCTR2, Revisited

progress.summary: The paper states that the two variants have tight committing-security bounds up to constants depending on n and explicitly leaves further optimization open.
citation_labels: Donghoon Chang et al., Key Committing Security of HCTR2, Revisited
